scientific_integrity: The proof uses exact finite field algebra, a complete 576-element stabilizer orbit, and geometric Jacobian rank over the algebraic closure; no extension sampling is substituted for geometric smoothness.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the field GF(2), cubic surfaces with three rational points and rational tangent planes; no higher-point tangent-filling classification.
Full published Dickson 1915 text and Karaoglu 2021 article download were inaccessible; publication priority remains uncertain.
title: Three-point tangent-filling cubic surfaces over \(\mathbf F_2\): a collinearity criterion and two orbits
